episode_order: cutoff timestamp ascending, then original client column ordinal; one training pass and frozen development readouts
eligibility: Exactly reuse feasibility v1 eligibility; no support-based client selection. Every eligible client/cutoff episode is included.

input_contract.events: 95 adjacent exact load comparisons in chronological order; sign code fall=0,tie=1,rise=2
input_contract.calendar_routes: weekday route=24+weekday (Monday=0); month route=31+(month-1); bias route=43

units.scalar: Unit strength 1 for every observed route
units.compact_event: Stateless pulse strength 1 for every observed route; must exactly match scalar predictions and updates
units.stateful_lif: One pure LIF per comparison route: v=0.95*v+0.6 on each global comparison tick, threshold=1, spike resets v=0 and starts two subsequent refractory ticks. During refractory ticks decrement counter and set v=0. Inactive nonrefractory units leak each tick. No dendritic nonlinearity. Reset all units at episode start. Route strength 1 if its unit spiked at least once, otherwise 0. Calendar/bias strength always 1.
units.stateful_reset_each_event: Same LIF calculation but reset v and refractory before each comparison tick. Calendar/bias unchanged.
units.scope: This comparison isolates the bundled temporal membrane/spike/refractory computation, not each mechanism individually. A later factorial protocol is required for attribution.

learning.signal: Receipt-bound binary rise/fall target arrives four logical intervals after prediction. Exactly the same outcome IDs and timing for all arms. One pending receipt, resolved before next episode; no global gradients. Development outcomes never update weights.

evaluation.primary: macro_client_brier; equally weight clients with at least one eligible non-tie development outcome
evaluation.reference: best development macro-client Brier among scalar and all three controls; no tuning
evaluation.calendar_block_gate: Positive improvement versus the same selected reference in at least 9 of 12 calendar months, with no month worse by more than 0.02. Fail closed if any month is empty.
evaluation.causal_gate: stateful_lif macro-client Brier must beat stateful_reset_each_event by at least 0.01
evaluation.parity_gate: scalar and compact_event prediction/update traces exactly equal
evaluation.resources: Report actual state bytes, event/tick/update counts and separate CPU process time for each arm; CPU is not energy. No CPU advantage claim from a single run.
evaluation.uncertainty: Client/calendar scores are correlated; no iid standard errors or significance claims. Calendar gate is a robustness check, not causal independence.

stop_rule: Run v1 once after synthetic contract tests. Failure of any adoption gate stops this exact candidate. Preserve every arm and negative result; do not change encoding, thresholds, parameters or task after scores. Even success does not authorize 2014 access.
next: Implement history-only episode adapter and matched learners; verify synthetic leakage, delayed receipts, parity, budget and metric tests before train/development scoring.
